# Riad Al Ashekin - Business & Technology Consultant & Strategist

> Business & Technology Consultant advising founders and executives on software architecture, commercial growth, AI automation, and search.

## Overview
Riad Al Ashekin is an executive consultant, operator, and software architect based in Bangladesh with global consulting practice. He specializes in aligning business reality with engineering decisions, eliminating tech debt, orchestrating pragmatic AI automations, and scaling organic search.

## Core Advisory Services
- [Advisory & Consulting Services](https://riadalashekin.com/services/): Strategic technical advisory, architectural roadmaps, and fractional CTO oversight.
- [Pricing & Retainers](https://riadalashekin.com/seo-pricing/): Flexible consulting retainers, technical audits, and sprint packages.
- [About & Background](https://riadalashekin.com/about-me/): Operating track record, executive credentials, and co-founded ventures.
- [Contact & Inquiries](https://riadalashekin.com/contact/): Direct consultation scheduling and project scoping.
